title: Smoking / Vaping Cessation Progress
dataSources: Alcohol drinks (`alcohol:drink`), vice logs (`vice:log`), hydration intake (`hydration:intake`), swear-jar entries (`swearjar:entry`).
app: Habit and sobriety trackers, alcohol-unit and hydration logs, vaping/smoking cessation apps, and a smart swear jar — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vice:log type=nicotine
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(count) as uses by _time
| eventstats avg(uses) as baseline
| eval reduction_pct=round(100*(baseline-uses)/baseline,1)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks your daily cigarette or vape count and how far it has fallen from your starting baseline.
value: Seeing the daily count drop is powerful motivation, and the money and health saved becomes tangible progress.
implementation: Log each use into `index=personal`; trend daily count and the reduction from baseline.
visualization: Line chart of daily nicotine use with a reduction percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how much you smoke or vape each day and how far you have cut down, cheering on your progress.
